name: Mitsushima Osamu
source: As one could already guess from his appearance, the third-year student Osamu is a kind man both to animals and people. Due to this, he often has to take care of such things as the class president's job and watering the flowerbeds.
translation: As one could already guess from his appearance, the third-year student Osamu is a kind man both to animals and people. Due to this, he often has to take care of such things as the class president's job and watering the flowerbeds.
